rationale: This revised plan addresses the two critical feedback items. First, feature_comparison now excludes the protected attributes (member_sex, member_race_ethnicity, member_age_band) and label-derived field (fraud_pattern_type) that created data leakage risk, retaining only 14 claim-level features and member_payer_type. Second, write_report now includes the 'no_operational_use' caveat alongside the existing four (synthetic_data, descriptive_only, association_not_causation, class_imbalance), explicitly stating that exploratory findings are not suitable for operational decisions. All other components and parameters remain unchanged from the prior plan.
changes_summary: Removed 4 prohibited fields (fraud_pattern_type, member_sex, member_race_ethnicity, member_age_band) from feature_comparison features list (14 features retained). Added 'no_operational_use' caveat to write_report caveats (5 caveats total).
